6.18.validation: 6.18.21 android17 common tree f957accaf563 compiled with gki_defconfig (4K pages, PREEMPT, MODVERSIONS, BTI/PAC, no LTO); 6.18 removed register_user_step_hook, so the EL0 single-step callback is taken over by rewriting the single BL arm64_force_sig_fault inside do_el0_softstep (located by the adjacent mov w0,#5 / mov w1,#2) into a core B to a newly allocated immutable gateway page in the +/-128 MiB vmalloc window; the gateway jumps absolutely into the module stub, which saves the full register file, dispatches in C and rewrites its resume tail into an absolute jump back to gateway+64 -> BL+4. __versions cleared; no static percpu; 2026.11.4.2 removes task_work_add from the import table (vendor kernels list it as a protected symbol and reject the load with -EACCES "Unresolved symbol task_work_add"); 2026.11.6.4 removes the unused HEZI/GUO legacy ioctls (40-44) and their handlers, and hwliming.h drops the matching API; 2026.11.6.5 applies the re-audit: per-section BTF length limits (the old str_off+str_len check rejected real ARM64 BTF), u16 magic + exact version/flags, and the legacy active_bp/deferred perf branch removed from the gateway dispatcher;
